features: 🔇 Active Noise Cancelling – Step into the world of noise-free listening with ANC technology that minimizes surrounding noise (Up to 33 dB), creating an immersive environment for music, audiobooks, or focused work sessions.

🎧 Comfort-Fit Lightweight Design – Featuring soft cushioned ear cups and a lightweight frame, these headphones are built for extended wear. The ergonomic design ensures comfort during long flights, workdays, or gaming sessions.
